svg.aria-label: Letter-spacing of each line over one period: in phase mode each line peaks at a different time; in tide mode the peak travels down the paragraph
svg.text: mode: 'phase' — each line on its own offset
looser (±0.012 em, the default amplitude) · ○ = each line's loosest moment
One 3.5 s period of a 7-line Merriweather paragraph, sampled every frame in Chromium from dist/core.js (scripts/measure.mjs).
